references.text: The central command to love the Lord your God with all your heart and all your soul, also mentioned in Deuteronomy 13:4
The Lord tests his people to know what is in their hearts, the same theme of divine testing
Warnings against false prophets and how to recognize them
Jeremiah warns against listening to prophets who speak lies and not the word of the Lord
Ezekiel warns against false prophets who prophesy from their own hearts
Jesus warns against false prophets who come in sheep's clothing
Jesus quotes the command to love the Lord your God with all your heart and all your soul
Jesus warns that false prophets will arise and perform signs and wonders to lead people astray
John urges testing the spirits to see if they are from God, for many false prophets have gone out into the world
